newsitem.title: FRANCE: RENAULT, SISU OY SET TO SEAL VENTURE PACT.
newsitem.headline: RENAULT, SISU OY SET TO SEAL VENTURE PACT.

text.p: French car and truck maker Renault SA is in talks with Finnish state-owned vehicle manufacturer Sisu Oy to seal a joint venture agreement announced in June and expects the distribution accord to be finalised in around 15 days, a senior Renault official said on Tuesday.

Elios Pascual, deputy managing director of Renault V.I., Renault's trucks division, told Reuters the French company was not in discussions to buy Sisu Oy's trucks division, as was suggested by a Sisu Oy official earlier this week.
"We're not negotiating taking over Sisu's truck activities," Pascual said in a telephone interview.
He said the agreement under discussion entailed the creation of a 50-50 joint venture which would comprise Sisu Oy's 20 or so dealers in Finland.
The venture would distribute Sisu Oy and Renault vehicles in Finland and study any synergies in distributing vehicles to neighbouring Nordic countries.
The accord also envisages the delivery by Renault of mechanical parts, mainly motors, to Sisu Oy, which is part of the Valmet group.
These activities were covered in a preliminary agreement between the two companies announced in mid-June.
Pascual said he expected the accord to be finalised in around 15 days.
Sisu Oy managing director Christer Granskog said in a television interview on Sunday that he could not exclude the possibility that Renault might buy its truck business.
Pascual said there appeared to be some misunderstanding or misinterpretation, as such a deal was "out of the question".
Another Renault official said Renault V.I. had sufficient production capacity in France.
